name: hako and mewo
source:
the 22nd of september. the last day of summer. according to urban legend, on this night, stars can be collected and exchanged for a wish. 

this wish will be fulfilled in the next life.

[From [url=https://inuu104.itch.io/hako-and-mewo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
9月22日，夏天的最后一天。据都市传说所言，在这一晚，人们可以收集星辰，用它们换取一个愿望。

而这个愿望，将在来生得以实现。

[摘自[url=https://inuu104.itch.io/hako-and-mewo]itch.io[/url]]
